name: cursor_tuple_fraction
description: Controls the planner's estimate of the fraction of cursor rows that will be retrieved, influencing plan selection between fast-start (e.g., index scans) and overall-optimal (e.g., sequential scans) strategies.
symptoms: Suboptimal plan choice for cursor queries
Excessive disk I/O due to sequential scan when index scan would be faster
Poor latency for interactive applications using DECLARE/ FETCH
tuning_tips: Increase toward 1.0 for cursors where most or all rows will be fetched (e.g., batch exports); decrease toward 0.01–0.05 for interactive cursors fetching only a few rows (e.g., paginated UIs). Observe EXPLAIN ANALYZE output for cursor plans before and after change.
